summary: Source review of what the payload kernel already offers a loader after C checkpoint 21: its console text is collected in loader_log (serial_putc_crlf and kmoutput call loader_log_putc), loader_jump hands the stub the log's PA and length in x0/x1 at every stop and at the orderly end, the kernel returns by itself on panic or on boot-arg loader_return_after (absent from the payload cmdline), storage entry points are the 29 register-only stubs, and the engine can carry a paced log. The README fixes the minimal design (dump at the last stop, run on, dump at the reason-0 return) and lists the unknowns with the check that resolves each. No hardware claim.
